title: Quasi-visual approximations
summary: We develop the foundations of the theory of quasi-visual approximations of bounded metric spaces. Roughly speaking, these are sequences of covers of a given space for which the diameters of the sets in the covers shrink to zero and for which relative metric quantities (such as ratios of diameters and distances) are uniformly controlled. This framework has applications to questions in quasiconformal geometry.
